project.description: Build an 8-bit policy/value accelerator shell as a complete SR2FPGA Verilog RTL project. This is component topology t7_policy_value_shell, difficulty tier T7. Use config_reg_bank and observation_stage feeding policy_score_core, then action_select_core, then stream_stage. The design must implement this black-box behavior: configuration writes set weights, biases, and enable; observation pairs are staged, scored, compared, and emitted as selected action plus value estimate. Keep rtl/top.v as the integration wrapper and keep each reusable component in a separate RTL file. Preserve these interface contracts: top.cfg_valid -> config_reg_bank.cfg_valid; top.cfg_addr -> config_reg_bank.cfg_addr; top.cfg_data -> config_reg_bank.cfg_data; config_reg_bank.cfg_ready -> top.cfg_ready; top.obs_valid -> observation_stage.in_valid; top.obs0 -> observation_stage.obs0; top.obs1 -> observation_stage.obs1; observation_stage.in_ready -> top.obs_ready; observation_stage.out_valid -> policy_score_core.in_valid; observation_stage.obs0_out -> policy_score_core.obs0; observation_stage.obs1_out -> policy_score_core.obs1; config_reg_bank.weight0 -> policy_score_core.weight0; config_reg_bank.weight1 -> policy_score_core.weight1; config_reg_bank.bias0 -> policy_score_core.bias0; config_reg_bank.bias1 -> policy_score_core.bias1; config_reg_bank.enable -> policy_score_core.enable; policy_score_core.out_valid -> action_select_core.in_valid; policy_score_core.score0 -> action_select_core.score0; policy_score_core.score1 -> action_select_core.score1; action_select_core.out_valid -> stream_stage.in_valid; action_select_core.selected_action -> stream_stage.selected_action; action_select_core.value_estimate -> stream_stage.value_estimate; stream_stage.out_valid -> top.action_valid; top.action_ready -> stream_stage.out_ready; stream_stage.selected_action_out -> top.selected_action; stream_stage.value_estimate_out -> top.value_estimate. Include system_his.json, manifest.json, timing constraints, predicted QoR, and a bounded self-checking testbench that prints TEST_PASS only on success or TEST_FAIL on failure.
